whatsNew: The user dashboard has been rebuilt into a more advanced luxury cinematic glassmorphism experience across the website and Android app.
The dashboard now has stronger visual hierarchy, premium glass surfaces, cinematic lighting, depth, responsive layouts, and smoother micro-interactions.
The dashboard now surfaces notifications more prominently while preserving the existing wallet, competitions, activity, challenges, gifts, spin, and account functionality.
Android build 46 includes the updated dashboard UI and responsive styling, with reduced-motion support and mobile WebView performance considerations.
